title: Discussion paper on Amendments on recruitment rules for Salt Commissioner
text: SCHEDULE – II (See sub-rule (1) of rule 7) Name of post Number of post Classification Scale of pay Whether selection post or non-selection post Age limit for direct recruits Educational and other qualification required for direct recruits 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 Salt Commissioner 1 *(2016) *Subject to variation dependent on workload Indian Salt Services, Grade-I, Group ‘A’ Gazetted (PB-4 Rs.37,400- 67,000/- Grade Pay Rs.8,900/- Selection Not applicable Not applicable -- 1 of 4 -- Whether age and Educational qualifications prescribed for direct recruits will apply in the case promotes Period of Probation, if any Methods of recruitment whether by direct recruitment or by deputation/transfer and percentage of the vacancies to be filled by various methods In case of recruitment by promotion/deputation/transfer, grades from which promotion/deputation/transfer to be made If a Departmental Promotion Committee exists, what is its composition. 8 9 10 11 12 Not Applicable Not Applicable By promotion failing which by transfer on deputation. By promotion : Grade –II Officers of the Indian Salt Service with 6 years’ regular service in the grade. Transfer on deputation (including short term contract) officers of Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings/Statutory/Autonomous Organisations- (a) (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis : or (ii) with 2 year’s regular service in posts in the scale of PB-4 Rs.37,400- 67,000 with Grade Pay Rs.8,700/- or (iii) with 6 years regular service in posts in the scale of PB-3 Rs.15,600- 39100 with Grade Pay Rs.7,600/- DPC for considering promotion (i)Chairman/Member, UPSC – Chairman. (ii)Additional Secretary, Department of Industrial Policy & Promotion – Member (iii) Joint Secretary, Department of Industrial Policy & Promotion – Member -- 2 of 4 -- (b) Possessing the following educational qualification and experience : Essential : Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry from a recognized University. OR Degree in Chemical Engg./Technology from a recognized University/Institution or equivalent; Desirable : Master’s degree in Chemistry from a recognized University or equivalent. (period of deputation including period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organization/department of the Central Government shall not ordinarily exceed 4 years) -- 3 of 4 -- Circumstances in which Union Public Service Commission is to be consulted in making recruitment 13 Consultation with UPSC is necessary for appointment of officers on Deputation(ISTC) -- 4 of 4 --
